title: CHANNEL_MANIFEST / ShipReleaseEnvelope
description: Content discovery SoT on GH/CDN. r5fms is policy SoT only (releases.name = SDK_VERSION). gate_name/sdk_version must be WireVersion, never catalog semver.

kind.description: Document kind. channel_manifest and ship_release_envelope are aliases.

sdk_version.description: WireVersion / SDK_VERSION. Sole r5fms gate key (releases.name). Never catalog semver.

gate_name.description: Optional alias for sdk_version. When set must equal sdk_version.

marketing_tag.description: Shell / GH / display version. Independent of WireVersion.

prerelease.description: True for beta content/shell; GA wire uses allowed=true only on production MS.

base_url.description: Optional CDN/GH base for relative asset URLs.

client.description: Client content track tip. Null/omitted = client track not shipped this envelope.

server.description: Server/dedi content track tip. Null/omitted = server track not shipped this envelope.

platform.description: Live overlay tip (scripts + optional runtime). Null/omitted = no overlay this envelope.

script_checksums.description: Optional u32 audit list for release_name=SDK_VERSION. Never install file verify.

notes.description: One-line current-tip blurb. Full changelog is NOTES.json.

notes_url.description: Optional NOTES.json URL. When omitted the shell loads NOTES.json next to this CHANNEL.

content_hash.description: Folded content identity from base/patch meta.json content_hash.

share_manifest_url.description: URL or file:// path to SHARE_MANIFEST.json for this tip.

local_install_hint.description: Local testing only: absolute install root when assets are empty.

base.description: Full-track base. Assets may be empty until share infra is wired.

patches.description: Ordered contiguous patches. Assets may be empty until share infra is wired.

assets.description: Asset inventory for this track. Empty allowed for v1 local play (install_hint).

url.description: Absolute https://, file://, or base_url-relative path.

sha256.description: Required for public ship; optional for local placeholders.
